{{Infobox auto}}

'''Cooked chicken''' is cooked meat. Like all meat in Matcha Flavoured, it has no [[intrinsic]]: it heals {{Hp|4}} and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_chicken.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Raw chicken cooks in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. The vanilla recipes are replaced, and in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] it becomes [[Charred Meat|charred meat]] instead.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|4}}.

Cooked chicken makes [[Chicken Nugget|chicken nuggets]] and [[pupusa]]s and can top a [[Pizza|meat pizza]]. Raw chicken goes into [[Ramen Stock|ramen stock]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Raw Chicken ==
{{Vanilla|Raw Chicken}}
'''Raw Chicken''' is dropped by animals as in vanilla. It keeps its vanilla food values and doesn't heal. As in vanilla, it has a 30% chance to give {{EffectLink|Hunger}}, which has no lasting effect in the pack.
{{Uses|Raw Chicken}}

== Trivia ==
* The developer made meat plain so that players have less reason to build animal farms: "since animal flesh holds no special properties, players will be less incentivized to manufacture slaughterhouses".<ref>{{Cite video|quote=And since animal flesh holds no special properties, players will be less incentivized to manufacture slaughterhouses.}}</ref>
